Sandbox_TLG_CampaignSpeed_tooltip: How quickly stored fuel deteriorates. Game-balance values, not real shelf lives.
Sandbox_TLG_ExistingSavePolicy_tooltip: How fuel ages when the mod is added to a world that already exists. Chosen once per world.
Sandbox_TLG_ProtectIncompatiblePours_too: Pouring a fuel an engine cannot use requires an explicit experimental action.
Sandbox_TLG_WrongFuelDamage_tooltip: Diesel in a petrol engine, or petrol or ethanol in a diesel: the engine runs badly and wears or breaks. Off: such fuel only blocks the start.
Sandbox_TLG_StationContamination: Station tanks start with water and sediment
